title: OpenVA Hosted Job Record
description: Operational metadata for one hosted resolver job in the durable job store. Data-minimised and transient by design: it carries NO uploaded inventory content, NO vendor identity strings, and NO request bodies — only a request digest, a row count, lifecycle state, and a TTL. It is deleted on expiry. Non-advisory: it never carries a verdict, score, risk level, approval, or suitability. additionalProperties is false so a leaked inventory or identity field fails validation. Operational metadata only; not legal, compliance, procurement, security, KYC, AML, audit, or vendor-risk advice.

job_id.description: Opaque correlation id (UUIDv4). Carries no submitted content; safe to log.

request_digest.description: SHA-256 over the canonical request for idempotency/dedup only. The request itself is never stored. SHA-256 only (bot constitution).

result_ref.description: Opaque pointer to the transient result blob (also TTL-deleted), or null until completed.

error_code.description: Stable, generic failure code (never an upstream message or submitted content).
